hints: Talking to Sir Hurlay:
Sir Hurlay: Hm... Then, once you have entered the dam, you should avoid returning here. I would hate to see you escape, but be caught returning to the scene of the crime.
Interact and walk into the door on the side of the dam to enter.
A short cutscene plays back in the rose room in Oshman's Manor, where a guard is inspecting the area.
Commander Balsura: So this is the scene of the robbery, then. And you say they took the key to the dam?
Butler Hayn: Yes sir. It is.
Commander Balsura: This room is too open to guard effectively. Reverse psychology doesn't work on thieves- they'll check the obvious spots to cover their bases.
Commander Balsura: By this point...they likely will have gone into the dam. I'll have to mobilize the forces and deal with them.
Commander Balsura walks out of the door to the room.
Commander Balsura: I'll be reporting this. You'll get a replacement key, but lose it again and you'll be relieved of your responsibilities. Consider this your one chance.
Butler Hayn: Time to clean...
▸ Entrance Area
The first area of the dam interior has a tunnel with a few enemies that leads to a room filled with pipes.
After reaching the end of the tunnel, there are various pipes around the room that can be entered using right-click. These pipes are indicated by the swirling green particles.
Enter the pipes in this order.
First: Head straight to [-15420, 53, -41].
Second: Head straight to [-15420, 60, -53].
Third: Turn east to and go to [-15408, 64, -57].
Fourth: Head straight to [-15408, 53, -67], then do a short parkour over to the other raised ledge to the west.
Fifth: Take the pipe with the black glazed terracotta at [-15439, 59, -64].
Instead of taking the fourth pipe, there is an optional pipe at [-15436, 53, -56] that leads to two Tier 2 Loot Chests.
▸ Central Area
After exiting the pipe, there is another longer tunnel section. Follow the path to the end, the door is at [-15335, 89, -65].
The door takes the player outside of the dam. There is a large lever at [-1603, 70, -1237] that can be activated.
After activating the lever:
The water should be active now. You should return back into the dam.
After re-entering the dam:
The water is flowing again. You should follow it to see where it goes.
Back-track through the central area to the very beginning of the tunnel. The water will activate a waterwheel and open the door at [-15389, 63, -47].
▸ Steam Vents Room

This room has a unique parkour mechanic in the form of steam columns. While in the column, the steam will push the player upward, and, upon exiting the column, launch the player in the direction they are looking (e.g. looking forwards launches the player forward, looking downwards launches the player downward).
Just past the first steam column, there is an optional pipe at [-15368, 63, -51] that leads to a parkour with two Tier 2 Loot Chests.

Towards the back of the area is a parkour that uses both steam columns and pipes. Scale up the parkour to reach the switch at [-15360, 97, -48]. This will open another door that allows what to flow on a different path in the central area; progress through the area in a similar manner as the first time. The water will activate a waterwheel and open the door at [-15379, 78, 7].
▸ Gear Room

There is a short hallway behind the door, with a Tier 1 Loot Chest at the end. Going through the nearby pipe transports the player to a large arena surrounding the Erroneous Gear miniboss. There are also several steam columns in the arena.

Shortly after depleting the Erroneous Gear to around 80% HP, the gear becomes invulnerable, and Commander Balsura arrives through the pipe in the wall as a secondary boss. However, only the Erroneous Gear is required to be destroyed in order to progress.
Commander Balsura: So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the game... trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
Commander Balsura: I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!

After destroying the gear, the bridge the in the central area rotates and directs the flow of water across the gap. Follow the water to the west until reaching the exit of the dam at [-15476, 52, -8]. A short cutscene plays where the water fills up the river.

stages.title: Stage 5
stages.task: Give Zhight his supplies
hints: ▸ Tips
Make sure you have a Climbing Helmet to access Maro Peaks. In order to obtain it, you must complete the Ice Nations quest.
This quest takes you on a journey all over the ocean, so it might take a while to complete. Make sure to bring enough emeralds to get around quickly using the V.S.S. Seaskipper.
